ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.25:1 high-to-low intensity ratio; the fluke is predominantly low-intensity (dark) with high-intensity (white) mottle concentrated at the distal leading edges and extreme tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity mottle located at the distal 15% of the left and right lobes; scattered focal high-intensity rings (circular scars) distributed across the medial and lateral dark regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 115 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 8% of the total vertical bounding box of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher amplitude jagged peaks compared to the more weathered, rounded serrations on the left lobe; distinct notch-like indentation on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a broad convex sweep reaching its maximum width at the mid-lobe before tapering to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly distinct spatial clusters of circular, hollow-center pixel rings; three prominent rosettes on the left lobe proximal to the leading edge; two isolated rosettes on the central right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine-scale vertical and diagonal linear disruptions; a set of three parallel vertical rake marks in the lower-central region of the right lobe; multiple unaligned horizontal scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) consistent with historical barnacle colonization; distinct vertical rake marks on the ventral right lobe; clusters of live, calcified organisms (barnacles) adhered to the trailing edge tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple live, high-intensity, textured barnacle clusters localized exclusively on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
